WSDC Event Data Registry — Public results vs Competition Results

WSDC public results = finals and points as published by WSDC. Competition Results = extended round-level data (prelims, judges, final partners) from scoring platforms. Partners are full only when prelims exist (who danced with whom); without prelims, at most partial (point placings only).

Dance Convention: competitors may hide their names (redacted). Events sourced from DC are marked DC redact — prelim rows can look complete while some people are missing.

Checklist = skill-level Jack & Jill only (Newcomer→Champions). Prelims: a division whose final was scraped but has no prelim round counts as finals-only (likely not held), not as missing data. A division known only from WSDC public results (not in scoring data) is a gap. Other divs (Masters, Sophisticated, Strictly, Switch, All American, …): click yes for the list from Competition Results. Generated 2026-10-25 20:30 UTC.

Software priority: Confirmed = Competition Results scrape source (platform prelims came from); if not scraped — this edition's Results Form; Likely = another year's Results Form for the same event; Needs verification = neither scrape nor form.
